TermsOfServices.title: Terms of Services
TermsOfServices.intro: Please read this before playing. It's short, because the product is simple: virtual capital, no real money, and a couple of ground rules for fair play.
TermsOfServices.section1: This is a real-time, two-player trading simulation. You trade a simulated BTC/USDT market against another player using virtual capital only. No real money is used, deposited, withdrawn, or traded on this platform at any point. Nothing here is real financial trading, and nothing you do here has any monetary value outside the app.
TermsOfServices.section2: You need an account to play. You're responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for anything that happens under your account. Don't share your login with anyone else, and let us know if you think someone's accessed your account without permission.

The market data is a simulation intended for entertainment and practice. Performance here has no bearing on how any real asset would perform, and you should never make real financial decisions based on anything in this app.

We don't guarantee the service will always be available, bug-free, or that match history and stats will be preserved indefinitely. We'll try to communicate meaningful changes, but we don't promise advance notice for every one.

PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicy.intro: A short summary of what we collect, why, and who can see it. No real money and no payment details are ever involved.
PrivacyPolicy.section1Intro: When you create an account and play, we store:

section1Items.account: Your email address and password, handled by our authentication provider (Supabase Auth) — we never see or store your raw password ourselves
section1Items.username: A public username, shown to other players
section1Items.matchRecords: Match records: rooms you've created or joined, match settings, start/end times
section1Items.tradingActivity: Trading activity: your trades within a match — side, amount, entry price, and timing
section1Items.matchOutcomes: Match outcomes and aggregate stats: games played, wins, losses, draws, win percentage

PrivacyPolicy.section2: We don't collect payment details, banking information, or anything related to real money — this platform uses virtual capital only, and no real financial transactions happen through it. We don't run third-party ad tracking.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Intro: We use the data above to:

section3Items.runMatches: Run matches - matching you with an opponent, streaming market data, computing balances and results
section3Items.showStats: Show your username and stats to other players, and to you
section3Items.matchHistory: Keep match history so you can review past games
section3Items.security: Keep the platform secure and prevent abuse

PrivacyPolicy.section4: Your opponent in a live match sees your username and your live capital total, but not your individual trades until the match ends. After the match, both players' full trade history for that match becomes visible to each other, as part of match history. Your email address is never shown to other players.
PrivacyPolicy.section5: We keep your account and match history for as long as your account exists. If you delete your account, we'll remove your personal data, though some anonymized match records may be retained for platform integrity.
PrivacyPolicy.section5Note: TODO: confirm actual deletion behavior once account deletion is implemented — this section should match what the code actually does, not just what's intended.
PrivacyPolicy.section6: You can update your username and log out at any time from settings. You can contact us to request a copy of your data or to have your account deleted.
PrivacyPolicy.section7: Authentication and password handling are managed by Supabase Auth. Database access is protected by Row Level Security policies, so you can only read or modify data your account is authorized to access.
PrivacyPolicy.section8: We may update this policy as the product changes. If we make a material change, we'll update the date at the top of this document.

HowToPlay.title: How to play
HowToPlay.intro: Two players, one BTC/USDT chart, equal starting capital. Whoever finishes the match with more capital wins.

createJoin.title: Create or join a room
createJoin.detail: Create a room and you're automatically seated as player one. Join an open room and you're seated as player two. Either way, the match settings (symbol, duration, starting capital) are locked in.

countdown.title: Countdown
countdown.detail: Once both seats are filled, a short countdown starts. Nobody can trade yet. This is just enough time to get ready before the chart goes live.

live.title: The match goes live
live.detail: Both players see the exact same price stream. From here you can place Long or Short trades until the clock runs out.

settlement.title: Settlement
settlement.detail: The moment the timer hits zero, any exposure you're still holding is automatically closed at the final price. Nothing carries over.

trading.title: Placing a trade
trading.intro: Every trade is a market order. You pick an amount and a direction, and it fills instantly at the current streamed price. There's no limit order, no leverage, and no fees.

long.label: Long
long.detail: You profit if the price rises above your entry price by the time you offset or the match ends.

short.label: Short
short.detail: You profit if the price falls below your entry price by the time you offset or the match ends.

trading.positionTitle: You only ever hold one position
trading.positionDetail: There's no separate “close” button. An opposite-side trade offsets your existing exposure first, and any leftover amount opens a new position in the other direction.
trading.positionExample: e.g. holding a $50 Short → a $50 Long trade fully closes it. A $80 Long would close the $50 Short and open a new $30 Long.

priceTimer.label: Price & timer
priceTimer.detail: Top bar — current price and time left in the match.

capital.label: Your capital
capital.detail: Available balance plus whatever's tied up in an open position.

exposure.label: Exposure panel
exposure.detail: Your current side, entry price, and unrealised profit or loss if you offset right now.

opponent.label: Opponent
opponent.detail: You'll see their capital total live. Their individual trades stay hidden until the match ends.

ending.title: How a match ends
ending.detail: When the timer runs out, the server closes any open position at the final price. You never have to remember to close a trade yourself. Whoever ends up with more capital wins. If you're tied exactly, it's a draw. Full trade-by-trade detail is available afterward from the match history.

ready.title: Ready?
ready.detail: Jump into an open room, or start your own.
